name: Verifying Proper Stucco Inspection Before Exterior Painting

mainEntity.name: How can I tell if an exterior painter in Los Angeles County is really checking for stucco moisture and hairline cracks, not just painting over them?
mainEntity.text: How can I tell if an exterior painter in Los Angeles County is really checking for stucco moisture and hairline cracks, not just painting over them?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many exterior painting failures in Los Angeles County come from painting over marginal stucco rather than addressing underlying moisture and cracking. Before hiring, pay attention to the estimator’s behavior during the site visit. They should do a slow walk-around, touching walls, looking closely at window corners, parapets, and transitions where cracks usually form. Good contractors mark cracks with chalk or tape, distinguish hairline cracks from wider structural cracks, and explain how each type will be treated. Ask whether they ever use a moisture meter on suspicious areas, especially near planters, downspouts, or flat roofs, and what moisture levels would make them postpone painting. A painter simply glancing around and measuring linear footage without examining walls closely is a red flag. Request that your written proposal describe how hairline cracks, larger cracks, and failed patches will be handled (for example, elastomeric patching, stucco repair, or skim-coating) and which specific primer will be used on repaired areas. During the project, you can walk the home with the crew leader before painting begins to confirm that all identified cracks and problem zones have been properly addressed. This upfront diligence is critical for a long-lasting finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Verifying proper stucco checks means watching for a full walk-around inspection, close-up crack marking, probing soft spots, and sometimes using moisture meters. A thorough contractor explains which cracks they will fill, which need patching, and how their primer and coating system addresses existing minor stucco movement.
